name: WCEHB
recent: WCE Holdings Berhad 近期主要围绕 ESOS 计划推进：股东在 2026 年 8 月 24 日的 EGM 上通过设立 ESOS，并于 9 月 4 日生效，11 月 16 日向包括首席执行员在内的合资格人士发出 2369.8 万份期权。同期，大股东 Tan Sri Dato' Surin Upatkoon 在 8 月至 10 月间多次申报持股变动。
notable: 股东在 2026 年 8 月 24 日的 EGM 通过设立 ESOS，最多占已发行股份 2%。
ESOS 于 2026 年 9 月 4 日生效，期限 5 年。
2026 年 11 月 16 日根据 ESOS 发出 23,698,000 份期权，行使价 RM0.664，其中首席执行员 Lyndon Alfred Felix 获 2,650,000 份。
risks: ESOS 期权行使可能带来股份稀释。
公司最新季度仍录得净亏损 2449.6 万令吉。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 1.408 亿令吉，环比增长 5.0%，但同比下跌 64.3%；净亏损 2449.6 万令吉，净亏损率 17.4%，较上一季度的 5.4% 扩大。

recent_en: WCE Holdings Berhad has been focused on its ESOS: shareholders approved the scheme at the EGM on 24 August 2026, it took effect on 4 September, and on 16 November 2026 the company offered 23.698 million options to eligible persons including the CEO. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder Tan Sri Dato' Surin Upatkoon filed multiple changes in his interest between August and October.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the establishment of an ESOS of up to 2% of issued shares at the EGM on 24 August 2026.
The ESOS took effect on 4 September 2026 with a 5-year duration.
On 16 November 2026, 23,698,000 options were offered under the ESOS at an exercise price of RM0.664, including 2,650,000 to CEO Lyndon Alfred Felix.
risks_en: Exercise of ESOS options may lead to share dilution.
The company remained in a net loss of MYR 24.496 million in the latest quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 140.8 million, up 5.0% QoQ but down 64.3% YoY; net loss was MYR 24.496 million with a net margin of -17.4%, wider than -5.4% in the previous quarter.
